name: How long does a typical residential roof replacement project take?
description: A typical residential roof replacement for asphalt shingles takes 2 to 5 days, depending on roof size, complexity, and weather. Other materials may take longer.

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical residential roof replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a residential roof replacement project varies depending on factors such as the size and complexity of your roof, the weather conditions, and the roofing material chosen. On average, most standard asphalt shingle roof replacements for a typical residential home can be completed within 2 to 5 days. Larger or more complex roofs, or those using specialized materials like tile or slate, might take longer. We always aim to complete projects efficiently while maintaining high quality and safety standards.
